% A guard, for files of the document named like a .4ht file: a copy of
% the plain TeX macro file epsf.tex in the document's folder, as old
% papers ship one, read with \input. The copy's name ends in .ltx, so
% that it is not a fixture. As in the PDF, the picture is shown.
\documentclass{article}
\IfFileExists{./epsf.ltx}{}{\errmessage{No copy of epsf.tex beside the document}}
\input{epsf.ltx}
\begin{document}
A picture: \epsfbox{test-inputname-epsf.eps}
\end{document}
